about: English meaning written for this library (en-scriptures): line by line, plain and faithful to the words, from the words themselves, their grammar and the dictionaries (Monier-Williams, Apte); not copied from any source. [meaning, [footnotes]]

m01: Om. The earth by its abundance, the sky by its breadth, the mid-air by its greatness —
O goddess Aditi, in your lap I lay down Agni, the eater of food, for food to eat.
m02: This dappled bull has come striding forth; he has won his mother again,
and, going forth to heaven, his father too.
m03: He shines over thirty abodes; speech has taken refuge with the winged one (the sun).
Carry it towards him day after day.
m04: Breathing out from his breath, she moves within the luminous spheres.
The mighty one has lit up heaven.
m05: That I in anger scattered you far away in wrath, that I did so in distress —
that, O Agni, is easily made good for you: we kindle you again.
m06: Whatever of you, scattered away in wrath, lay strewn over the earth,
that the Ādityas, the Viśvedevas (the All-gods) and the Vasus gathered together.
m07: May the mind, which is light, delight in the ghee; may it join together this broken sacrifice.
May Bṛhaspati extend this sacrifice of ours; may the Viśvedevas rejoice here.
